description_expanded: Overview6 Seater Golf Cart/Option - The Big Chill- Community Pool 'Sugar Wave'The Space Luxury Prominence Retreat – Steps to The Big Chill & Resort-Style Pool! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Available with advance reservation Steps to The Big Chill (The Hub) – Walk to restaurants, live music, & entertainment 5,000 SF Community Pool & Fitness Center – Resort-style heated pools & private cabanas Spacious 3-Bedroom Condo – Beautifully decorated with open & airy living spaces Smart TVs & Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected & entertained Master Suite with King Bed & En-Suite Bath – Featuring a double vanity & stand-up shower Parking for 2 Vehicles – Golf cart included if rental option selected Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacationWelcome to Sugar WaveThe minute you open the door and enter this 3-bedroom condo you will be glad you booked this unit. It is beautifully decorated and has been equipped with all of the comforts and amenities you would expect. Open and airy main living, dining and kitchen space with natural light is the perfect place to make vacation memories. The master suite features a king-size bed, an en suite bath with double vanity and stand-up shower. The guest rooms feature a queen-sized bed and another with two twin over twin bunk beds with a shared full hallway bathroom. This beautiful townhome is located right across the street from the hub and is steps away from a resort-style pool. The Prominence pool features private cabanas, an outdoor dining pavilion, and a fitness center.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Notification required one week prior to arrival to reserve golf cart** 6-Seat Golf cart available for rent. $150 per day plus tax. Golf Cart must be rented for length of stay. Please request at checkout ***Golf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW:-To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and must be at least 25 years old-Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations-A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signaturesPLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.**If Prominence security catches any underage drivers they impose a $500 fine to the house, which the renter is responsible for paying.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private bathroom with showerGuest Bedroom: King sized bed, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboBunk Room: Two set of twin bunk beds, shared bathroom with tub/shower combo*** Golf Cart rental option available to add to the reservation. Guests must be 25 years or older to operate golf cart. Failure to adhere to the age limit for the golf cart will result in loss of golf cart use for the remainder of your stay.***Beach Access:Deer Lake State Park - 1 mile west , $3 parking FeeGulf Lakes Public Beach - 1.2 miles eastAREA ATTRACTIONS:The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) is a festive gathering place for friends and families to eat, drink, shop, and play. There are multiple restaurants plus Mr. Freeze ice cream, and plenty of fine retail shopping. The restaurants are situated around a lawn and patio area with comfortable seating, big stone wood grill, fireplace, event stage, and huge screen. There is music, drinks, entertainment, games and an arcade. There is easy access to the 30A hotspot "The Big Chill", a Pool House with heated pools.Show less
